latest_release.name: DuckDB v2.0.0 "Cyanoptera"
latest_release.body:
This release of DuckDB is named "Cyanoptera" after Spatula Cyanoptera, a species of duck found in western North and South America.

Please also refer to the announcement blog post: https://duckdb.org/2026/10/21/announcing-duckdb-200.html

## What's Changed
* Make `Identifier` a class instead of using string everywhere by @Mytherin in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23161
* Move to tidy-check diff again by @Mytherin in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23196
* Step 3: Make duplicate eliminator optimizer logic work for CTE rewrite by @kryonix in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23187
* Allow `MERGE INTO` in triggers by @Dtenwolde in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23179
* RETURNING support for tables with triggers by @krleonid in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23153
* Remove special formatting code for main CMakeLists.txt by @Mytherin in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23211
* Expand aggregate state export to work with lists (`StateListType`) and sort keys (`StateSortKey`), and add aggregate state export to `list`, `any_value/first/last`, `arg_min/arg_max` by @Mytherin in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23199
* Initial implementation of `variant_array_length` processing function by @sebastiaan-dev in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23167
* Add row group count to parquet RETURN_STATS by @pdet in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23218
* Unify `ProfilerPrintFormat` and `ExplainFormat` , remove special casing and move towards pluggable tree renderers by @Mytherin in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23222
* Rework `quantile` to use `list` infrastructure by @Mytherin in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23228
* Add `decimal_average` aggregate function by @Dtenwolde in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23097
* Step 4: Make unnest rewriter recognize CTE-based plans by @kryonix in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23240
* Rework ordered aggregates to use the `list` infrastructure by @Mytherin in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23231
* Pluggable combine types rules by @yan-alex in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23173
* Auto generate `select.gram` by @Dtenwolde in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23236
* Unify quantile `update/combine` callbacks with the list aggregate by @Mytherin in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23247
* Add `JSONBench` to the benchmark suite by @Mytherin in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23265
* Add support for static linking C-API extensions by @Maxxen in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22251
* Add `vertex_extract` function to get coordinates out of point-geometries by @Maxxen in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23252
* [Dev] Resolve `DEFAULT`s for INSERT/UPDATE/MERGE_INTO at bind-time rather than plan-time by @Tishj in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23033
* Consistent ordering for gen files in package_build by @staticlibs in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23267
* Transform type literals into unbound logical types by @d-justen in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23237
* Remove UnaryAggregateDestructor, and instead fold it into UnaryAggregate by @Mytherin in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23268
* Add comment policy for bots by @Mytherin in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23272
* Fix null sentinel for keys in dict vector (Arrow) by @evertlammerts in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22648
* Parquet: add expression stats pruning for arithmetic filters by @Damon07 in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23264
* Add `init_local_state_finalize` callback to aggregate functions which allows them to create a `FunctionLocalState` that is persisted across `Finalize` calls, and use this to speed up ordered aggregates by @Mytherin in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23270
* fix out-of-bounds read in strict time parsing by @jmestwa-coder in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/23266

detail.readme_excerpt: ## DuckDB DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system. It is designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. DuckDB runs in-process inside your application, so there is no separate server to manage and no external dependencies. It can also read remote files, query other databases, and connect to other DuckDB instances when needed. It provides a rich SQL dialect with support far beyond basic SQL: arbitrary and nested correlated subqueries, window functions, collations, and complex types (arrays, structs, maps). Its [friendly SQL](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/sql/dialect/friendly_sql.html) extensions add syntax that makes queries shorter and easier to write. DuckDB is available as a [standalone CLI application](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/clients/cli/overview) and has clients for [Python](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/clients/python/overview), [R](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/clients/r), [Java](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/clients/java), [Rust](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/clients/rust), [Go](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/clients/go), [Wasm](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/clients/wasm/overview), and [many more](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/clients/overview), with deep integrations with packages such as [pandas](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/guides/python/sql_on_pandas). For more information on using DuckDB, please refer to the [DuckDB documentation](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/). ## Reads and writes any data DuckDB reads and writes a wide range of file formats, including [CSV](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/data/csv/overview), [Parquet](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/data/parquet/overview), [JSON](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/data/json/overview), and [Excel](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/core_extensions/excel), directly from local disk or from remote endpoints such as S3, HTTP(S), Azure, and Google Cloud Storage.
